name: Pro Usage Metering Dashboard
description: Usage-based billing dashboard: per-meter cumulative series with limit and alert-threshold lines, quota bars with forecast overlay, linear forecast to period end with limit-exhaustion date, projected bill, a virtualised sortable cost breakdown by any dimension, an alert threshold editor and a preset date range picker.

examples.title: Cloud platform bill, 5 meters, ~29k usage records

props.name: meters
props.description: { id, name, unit, limit?, included?, unitPrice, per?, alertThresholds?: number[] (fractions) }

props.name: records
props.description: { meterId, date: 'yyyy-mm-dd', quantity, dimensions?: Record<string, string> }

props.name: defaultRange
props.description: Uncontrolled initial range; defaults to the month containing asOf

props.name: thresholds
props.description: Controlled alert thresholds per meter id

props.name: baseFee
props.description: Fixed platform fee added to the bill

props.name: forecastWindowDays
props.description: Trailing days averaged for the forecast rate

props.name: dimensions
props.description: Breakdown dimensions; inferred from records when omitted

props.name: error
props.description: Error message; shows an error state

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Retry button in the error state

usage: Overage cost = max(0, usage - included) / per * unitPrice; the breakdown allocates each meter's overage to a dimension in proportion to usage.
